about_the_game:
Berserker Girl is a 2.5D side-scrolling action game with tight platforming, intense boss battles, and a rich narrative told in a visual novel style.

A girl wakes up in a strange, otherworldly realm. With no idea how she arrived, she sets off in search of the King of All — a being said to hold the key to returning home. Along the way, she’ll battle shadowy foes, traverse surreal landscapes, and uncover fragments of a world both beautiful and broken.

⚔️ Fast-paced, responsive combat and challenging platforming
📘 Story-driven progression presented through visual novel-style dialogue
🧊 3D character models in a unique 2.5D visual style
👁️ Atmospheric and mysterious worldbuilding with hidden lore

Developed by HyperSoftMongsilSoftware — a tiny studio inspired by one very soft rabbit named Mongsil.
